title: A dual neural network images supercurrent networks in a cuprate superconductor
summary: A dual artificial neural network (VMAP) converts energy-resolved density of states maps from scanning tunneling data into supercurrent speed maps in Bi2Sr2CaCu2O8. For hole densities 0.17 to 0.22 it reveals statistically repeatable supercurrent networks that satisfy Kirchhoff's law at junctions, with speeds of 1250 to 4000 m/s consistent with theory. The date is that of the arXiv v2 listed; the first version date is not confirmed. Only the abstract was reviewed, with no independent replication.
